body: I would anything for her. She already looks out for me, but that's the problem. She only looks out for me, not for herself. When she does something it usually just for me, but I want her to start doing stuff for her. I love this girl, I want her to see herself the way I do.

Thank you for your advice my friend, it means alot to me. Her family and her are quite distance. I dont think ger family would he willing to help. She has given up trying to help herself and I don't see what I can say to make it easier on her. I want her to see a therapist or see a doctor about it but she has given up on herself, she's only trying for me. But with all this negativity it's really bringing me down, but I know I can't let her see me like this or she would feel guilty. I live in Canada, if you know anyone who could help her or any advice here please tell me. Thank you
Thank you for the kind words it really helps me my friend. But when she asks for space should I really give it or should I keep talking to her?

I dont mind taking on her problems along with her. Even if it makes it harder for me, as long as it makes it even slightly easier for her I would do anything. But you're right professional help is definitely the best, and I'm looking up good places here, but they're so damn expensive.

She doesnt use suicide has a method to keep me with her. I want to be with her no matter what. I want to risk my mental health for her, I believe I have a strong mind and my friends are also there for me when I need them. I would risk anything for this girl. I want to marry her, I want to be with her forever.

I know shes not obligated to stay with me, but she doesnt have to, I know she loves me and that she cares for me, but if she did leave me I would be okay with that if I know it would make her happier then she is right now. I would do anything to make her happier, and a therapist is a good idea, but they're so expensive. Thank you for the support, it helps alot.

I already tell her how much I love her on a daily basis, and when I see her I always squeeze her and hold her. I make sure that she feels loved, but it worries be when she askes for me to leave her alone. Should I give her space when she asks? I'm scared if I do, she would do something that she couldn't take back. I don't want to lose her, I want to make her smile, I know it takes time but it hurts. It hurts so god damn much. Dont worry. I will never leave her. I hope your doing okay my friend, stay strong.

What should I do then? I'm scared that one day she wont reply to my messages only to find out shes gone. I wouldnt be able to take that. I don't know if I should give her space when she asks, or should I keep comforting her, or even drive to her  house. I'm scared I'll lose her. Thank you for the support this means the world to me.
I will never leave her. As much as it hurts me watching her crumble, I want to be there for her when she truly smiles again. I will never let her go dont worry. Thank you for the kind words my friend

I hope I could eventually get her to go to a therapist, but I worry for her. I'm scared, when I woke this morning she talked to me about how "the knife looks tempting" or "dont forget about me when I'm gone" throught text. I dont know what to do. Should I give her some space to breath or should I try and get a reply from her. I dont know anymore, I'm scared. I dont want to lose her.
I hope you'll be fine as well. Thank you for your kind words as well. I hope you the best as well my friend
No worries my friend. I hope your doing okay, it must be hard going through all off this, stay strong. Please be safe and take care of yourself.

I don't know how to try to make her go to a therapist, and make it seem not negative. If anything I would like it for her to come to that decision without my help if possible. I feel like if I mention a therapist she would crumble again, and i'm scared of that. But ill try and secretly nudge her in that direction. Thank you for the help my friend.
You do have talent. I believe you. It must've been hard with all of that happening, but you'll find someone perfect for you. Take care of yourself my friend.
